Fresh crater atmospheric fits

Richard Archer · Atlas AstroBioTek · v2310CT v5

Explore the archived entry surrogate against all 27 published fresh-crater relief means. The surrogate includes drag and a heuristic survival weight, but no ablation. Pressure weights and fits are conditional on its assumptions. The separate drag–ablation calculations are provided below and in the CSV archive.

Choose a modeled state

Points: Archer (2023) Table 4 means ±1 SD. Curves: best sampled prediction for the selected state. All panels use the same relief scale.

Negative predictive R² means worse agreement than an elevation-invariant group mean. A high pooled R² can be driven by differences between crater-size groups. Fresh morphology does not establish Noachian formation age.

Pressure sensitivity

The historical 24-mean grid gives 3 bar 58.5% weight; all 27 means give 64.0%. Correct molar gas mixing raises the nominal weight to 72.6%, but using full observed SD in the likelihood flattens it to 20.7%. These are scenario sensitivities, not measured atmospheric probabilities.

Provenance and references

Archer (2023), Icarus 406, 115734. Source DOI. The fit report supplies complete methods, original input archives and references. No verified Archer 2025 crater paper was found. Newest impact reference: Abramov et al. (2026), Nature Communications 17, 9790. That study does not support categorical immunity to early impact sterilization.
